description: Tool authorization policies with the Main server parser's verdict. The shared schema must accept every valid policy and reject every invalid one except those marked server-only (rules the parser checks across fields) or yaml-syntax.

cases.name: minimal
cases.yaml: version: 1

cases.name: empty-rules
cases.yaml:
version: 1
defaultAction: deny
rules: []

cases.name: legacy-match
cases.yaml:
version: 1
defaultAction: allow
rules:
  - id: reviewer-read-master
    enabled: true
    match:
      agent: reviewer
      tool: { source: node, name: read }
      targetNode: master
      path:
        arg: filePath
        allWithin: '${agent.dir}'
    action: allow
    reason: Read the review workspace
  - id: reviewer-deny-other-tools
    match:
      agent: reviewer
    action: deny
  - id: empty-match
    match: {}
    action: allow

cases.name: shorthand-selectors
session-relations
external-peer
cases.yaml:
version: 1
rules:
  - id: peer-send-review
    match:
      externalId: peer
      tool: { source: builtin, name: send_to_session }
      args: { sessionId: project/review }
    action: allow
  - externalId: [peer, other]
    action: deny

cases.name: secrets
cases.yaml:
version: 1
rules:
  - agent: deploy-worker
    secrets: { anyOf: ['staging-*'] }
    action: allow
  - secrets: { anyOf: 'prod-*' }
    action: deny
    reason: Production credentials are changed by the user.
  - agent: deploy-worker
    secrets: { owned: true }
    action: ask

cases.name: ask-approval
cases.yaml:
version: 1
defaultAction: ask
rules:
  - id: confirm-production
    agent: ops
    tool: { source: node, name: exec }
    node: production
    action: ask
    reason: Commands on production
    approval:
      timeoutSeconds: 1800
      approvers: [alex, ops.team-1]
  - id: plain-ask
    tool: exec
    action: ask
    approval: {}

cases.name: operation-rules
cases.yaml:
version: 1
defaultAction: allow
rules:
  - id: no-node-switching
    op: node.select
    action: deny
    reason: Stay on the assigned Node
  - id: reviewer-reads-workspace
    agent: reviewer
    op: env.read
    path: { within: '${agent.dir}', notWithin: '${agent.memoryDir}' }
    action: allow
  - id: reviewer-no-other-reads
    agent: reviewer
    session: 'reviewer/*'
    op: [env.read, env.write]
    node: [master, 'dev/*']
    action: deny
  - op: '*'
    externalId: peer
    action: deny
  - op: session.*
    targetSession: { session: { self: true } }
    action: allow
  - op: session.create
    parent: { id: ['team/main'] }
    targetAgent: { descendant: true }
    with: { kind: child, fork: false }
    action: allow
  - op: task.update
    task: { owned: true }
    action: allow
  - op: channel.send
    channel: 'alpha:123'
    action: ask
    approval: { timeoutSeconds: 30 }
  - op: secret.use
    secret: { anyOf: [prod-*], owned: true }
    action: deny
  - op: mcp.call
    mcp: { server: project-tools, tool: lookup_* }
    action: allow
  - op: env.tool
    nodeTool: custom_*
    action: allow
  - op: model.request
    model: local/wire
    enabled: false
    action: deny
  - op: agent.view
    targetAgent: { id: team }
    action: allow
